cues: The pale interior separates into soft lengthwise sections when gently pulled apart.
A short, tough stem caps one end, while a dark blossom scar marks the other.
Fine, stringlike fibers cling to the flesh after the outer covering is removed.
Its firm green exterior gradually turns bright yellow as the interior becomes sweeter.
The ripe flesh mashes easily into a smooth paste with very little pressure.
Delicate tissue beneath the skin bruises readily, leaving brown marks after a bump.
